  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `prime_phase_concurrency_snapshot` runs `orchestrate_lib.py concurrency-caps` with `2>/dev/null`, so the `ZOMBIE_RUN_IGNORED ... guard=concurrency_snapshot` lines from `log_zombie_run_ignored(run, "concurrency_snapshot", effective_now_ts)` (orchestrate_lib.py:567-569) and the `::warning::ZOMBIE_RUN_MAX_QUEUED_HOURS` invalid-value warning are thrown away.
  WHY: Wedged queued runs dropped from the concurrency cap counts write no searchable log line, which breaks the issue's "each ignored run produces one searchable log line" goal and contradicts agents.d/9473-ignore-wedged-queued-runs.md:10; the dispatch decision itself is correct (all reviewers rated NIT, mapped to low; minimax_minimax-m3 raised the same root cause as a MAJOR task gap, listed under CONSENSUS TASK GAPS).
- scripts/orchestrate_lib.py:2549-2554 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_zombie_run_created_epoch` now returns None unless `created_at` ends with "Z", while the Bash twin `zombie_queued_jq_def` uses `fromdateiso8601`, which accepts offset suffixes such as `+08:00` on jq 1.7+; the test `test_wedged_queued_run_needs_a_z_suffixed_created_at` (tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py:4289-4294) locks this in.
  WHY: A wedged queued run with an offset timestamp would be treated as active by the Python guards (`unblock_scan.py:_busy_items` / `skip`, `ci_cancelled_rerun.py:process`, `build_concurrency_snapshot`) but dropped by every Bash guard, so wedged-run handling drifts across the pipeline (rated NIT, mapped to low; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked the minimax parity claim and found no mismatch, citing the jq `+08:00` test in tests/test_gh_helpers_zombie_queued.py).
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1364-1365 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The log filter picks runs by display title only, while the guard's active-run count at 1373 also requires the run name to match "Plan".
  WHY: `fetch_plan_runs_json` lists runs across the whole repository, so a wedged queued run from another workflow with the same display title is logged as `ZOMBIE_RUN_IGNORED` even though the Plan guard does not ignore it (rated NIT, mapped to low).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
